lv3.perQuality: 4 per quality would need 4/4 for 80%, contradicting 22/24

v1.delaySets: named in prose only; no frozen items

rules.pass: official pass requires the exact frozen same-day set (20/20 or 30/30 evaluated, no repeats), every quality block complete at of=5 with >= min, every level root covered, the exact delayed set (10/10 or 12/12) with >= pass, the ear set where the level has one, and the Lv3 speed ratio; invalid trials are excluded and must be re-tried
rules.independent: a correct result counts toward the official pass only when it is MIDI-confirmed and not hint-assisted; self-confirmation is a separate progress track and never a formal pass
rules.speed: only the Lv3 name-recall level; 80% of independent-correct attempts must have a recorded completionAt - armedAt <= 3000 ms; missing speed counts as not within the limit; invalid trials are excluded
rules.delay: different day (>= 24h and >= 12h apart is not enough alone); the delayed set is a frozen, disjoint item set; where a level has no spare cells the same cell reappears with a different authored placement; order alone is never a different problem
rules.hint: an audition/name hint or an ear replay marks the trial assisted; it counts as practice progress, never as an independent confirmation
rules.selfCheck: MIDI confirmation and self-confirmation are stored as different evidence; self-confirmation never promotes to MIDI-verified
rules.duplicate: an item id never repeats inside a same-day or delayed set; the frozen sets are disjoint by construction and a same-day repeat cannot add coverage
rules.invalid: disconnected / prepare-failed / clock-jump / capability / stall / hidden trials are excluded from every denominator, recorded with their reason, and re-tried
rules.noInput: no captured notes within the response timeout (10000 ms) is an attempt with result no-input, never a wrong answer or a device-invalid

answerPolicy.nameRecall: the quality's required tones under the product 'normal' leniency (root+3rd required; 5th optional; maj7/min7/dom7 require the 7th; min7b5 requires b5); an unspecified bass is free and any inversion is accepted; a bass is enforced only when the item specifies one; never a single fixed MIDI set
answerPolicy.savedVoicing: the authored notes are the gold: same notes, same octaves, same doubling; no theory-derived additions; this is a separate policy from name recall
answerPolicy.ear: accepted harmony (the same required tones) + the item's specified bass (root); exact voicing is not required; one playback, and a replay marks the trial assisted
